subject: On-site generator capacity issue + 5G hotspot failover for demo pods
messages:
From: Priority Venues Ops <ops@priorityvenues.com>
To: SooJin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: main generator tripped - risk to demo pods

Soojin / team —

We just lost the venue's primary generator (main breaker tripped when the second bank came online). Atlas on-site reports the installed generator can supply ~75kW steady; your estimate for full demo load was ~95kW. Right now we're seeing flicker on pod B and two demo monitors powered down. House Wi‑Fi is OK but the cellular signal inside the hall is weak — we can't rely on attendees' mobile networks for streaming.

Immediate risks:
- GPUs in demo pods might brownout under burst (risk of hardware resets)
- Live demo streaming to remote judges may drop

Attachments: site-load-report.csv (current draw snapshot), photo-stage-panel.jpg (outlet rack)

Atlas says they can bring an additional 50kW trailer but need 20–30 minutes to get permit/connection ready. Asking for go/no-go on: 1) immediate power-shedding of non-critical circuits (lights, signage), 2) activating vendor-provisioned mobile broadband (hotspots) and switching demos to low-power/recorded content until generator B is confirmed.

Please advise ASAP.

— Jonah (Priority Venues Ops)
From: SooJin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priority Venues Ops <ops@priorityvenues.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Atlas Generators <crew@atlasgen.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: main generator tripped - risk to demo pods

Jonah / Atlas / team — thanks for the heads up. Action plan (immediate):

1) Power: start shedding non-essential circuits now (house lighting to 30%, floor signage off). Atlas — prioritize delivering the 50kW trailer if usable; if there's any regulatory hold, confirm expected ETA.

2) Demo containment: Vanessa, please move Demo Pod B to Low‑Power Mode (GPU throttling + local playback) and unplug high‑draw bench equipment. Marissa — please spin up the prerecorded highlight reel we keep on the event USB as backup.

3) Cellular failover: we have a field kit of 5 pre-provisioned 5G hotspots in our event van (field-hotspot-inventory.csv). Vanessa, please configure them in round‑robin for the demo pods and position one as a broadcast uplink. Karthik, please coordinate an emergency SIM top-up with CityCell (I authorize up to $1,000 spend).

4) Comms: Atlas, confirm connection diagram and expected hookup time. Jonah, keep us posted on any further trips.

I'll be on-site in 10 minutes. If Avi (TribeApp) is en route, open the telepresence channel; otherwise proceed with local playback.

— SooJin Lee

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RESOLVED: generator + failover recap and post-mortem items

Closing the loop on the incident:

What happened: venue primary generator tripped at 08:10 when second bank came online; installed gen could not support peak demo load.

Immediate mitigations taken:
- Atlas connected two parallel distro boxes to provide ~45kW within 12 minutes; trailer hooked at ~22 minutes.
- Redwood field team spun up 5x 5G hotspots; Demo Pod B was switched to local playback; broadcast hotspot handled uplink with stable throughput.
- TribeApp founder Avi was delayed; prerecorded demo played to keep schedule on track.

Impact: no hardware damage, three demos experienced reduced fidelity for ~35 minutes, two brief reconnects for remote judges (no judging penalties received).

Action items (owner / due):
- Venue: provide corrected single-line generator rating (Priority Venues Ops) / due 2027-07-19
- Ops: formalize a pre-check list for generator N+1 and trailer permits (Atlas + Redwood ops) / due 2027-07-26
- Field: increase stock of pre-provisioned hotspots to 8 for large halls (Vanessa) / due 2027-08-02
- Sales/CS: offer TribeApp a one-month account credit for any perceived demo disruption (Marissa) / due 2027-07-16

Thanks to everyone for the quick response — we kept the schedule and attendees happy. I’ll open a short post-mortem doc in Drive and assign tasks.

— SooJin
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
